examples.trans: I could not possibly tell that story!

examples.text: Ты вчера сказала мне холодное нет.
examples.trans: Yesterday you said a cold no to me.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('cold').

examples.text: Ты вчера сказала мне холодное нет.
examples.trans: Yesterday you said a cold no to me.

examples.text: Холодная водка.
examples.trans: Cold vodka.

examples.text: Вот хорошая ты баба. Холодная.
examples.trans: You are a good woman. Cold.
